name: Matrix Fitness
verdict: The commercial fitness brand of Johnson Health Tech (Taiwan). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: 'MATRIX FITNESS' lettering appears on the shorts of Chile's current rugby kit (Nations Cup 2026 match photos); the follow-on of the January 2026 alliance under which Matrix Fitness equipped Chile Rugby's gym (Cooperativa). Ownership: Matrix is Johnson Health Tech's commercial brand (claim matrix-johnson-ownership). No state stake and no qualifying record identified.
